title: BOM can create negative stock
reproduction: Seed a BOM needing more than available stock
Add the service to a case
expected: Shortage is blocked or explicitly approved without silent ledger corruption.
actual: The full need is written to usage and decremented.
businessImpact: Inventory, COGS, and operational availability become unreliable.
recommendedFix: Enforce a transactional shortage policy and regression tests.

title: Removing service or case does not reverse BOM consumption
evidence: ho-so/actions.ts:253-265 deletes CaseService without compensating usage/movement; deleteCase does not restore consumed stock.
expected: Exact compensating movement or immutable cancellation policy.
actual: Consumption remains after the service/case is removed.
recommendedFix: Model source consumption and reverse transactionally; avoid unsafe hard delete.

title: Child server actions do not verify parent ownership
agent: Security Red Team; Manager; Data Integrity
evidence: ho-so/actions.ts:253-260,272-295,478-539,620-625,654-659,713-728 mutates children by id while locking a separate caseId.
reproduction: Submit a child ID from case A with case B as caseId
Check whether the child from A changes
actual: Source predicates do not consistently include the parent relation.
businessImpact: Horizontal case tampering and cross-patient corruption.
recommendedFix: Authorize and query child records with the actual parent in one predicate.

title: Authenticated media access is not record-scoped
evidence: web/src/app/media/[file]/route.ts:39-48 passes any session before serving the requested filename.
reproduction: Learn a filename belonging to case A
Request it with user B session
expected: Access is granted only for the authorized case/customer.
actual: A valid session is sufficient after filename resolution.
businessImpact: Clinical photos and documents may cross patient or role boundaries.
recommendedFix: Store ownership metadata and enforce record-scoped authorization for every media response.

title: Shareholder view renders clinical/customer details too broadly
evidence: permissions.ts grants customer access to SHAREHOLDER; khach-hang/[id]/page.tsx:180-183,246-309 renders medical alert, cases, photos, and care history.
reproduction: Open a populated customer with an isolated SHAREHOLDER account
Inspect medical alert, cases, photos, care, and totals
expected: Minimized management view or explicit clinical capability.
actual: Module access renders the full customer detail surface.
businessImpact: Unnecessary health-data disclosure and least-privilege failure.
recommendedFix: Split summary, clinical, photo, financial, and care capabilities.

title: Reception and telesale can edit sensitive medical fields
evidence: khach-hang/actions.ts:31-45,55-64,101-110 permits these roles and writes allergies, medicalHistory, and contraindications.
reproduction: Use isolated RECEPTION or TELESALE account
expected: Clinical write capability is separate and auditable.
actual: The role allowlist includes the write path.
businessImpact: Safety-critical context can be altered by non-clinical workflows.
recommendedFix: Split schemas/actions and require explicit clinical capability.

title: Photo upload trusts unrelated case and customer IDs
evidence: ho-so/actions.ts uploadPhoto accepts caseId and customerId independently and creates both without relation validation.
reproduction: Submit a valid case ID with a different customer ID in an isolated DB
expected: Mismatched ownership is rejected; customer is derived from case.
businessImpact: Sensitive images can be filed under the wrong patient.
recommendedFix: Derive customer from case server-side and ignore client customerId.

title: Public booking clears fields after invalid phone error
evidence: Browser reproduction on /dat-lich: invalid phone error appeared and name/phone values were cleared.
reproduction: Enter a name and invalid phone
expected: Keep valid fields and focus the invalid field.
actual: Entered values were cleared after the server response.
businessImpact: Patients abandon or repeat work; reception has more correction calls.
recommendedFix: Preserve form state and return field-level errors.

title: Public service selector is long and inconsistent
evidence: Browser DOM showed a very large flat native service list with inconsistent labels.
reproduction: Scan the list for a common service
expected: Searchable/grouped catalog with clear patient language.
actual: Patient must scan a long flat list.
businessImpact: Choice friction and reduced trust at the acquisition boundary.
recommendedFix: Add categories, search, popular services, and content QA.

title: ESLint release gate fails
evidence: Runtime npx eslint reported 11 errors and 1 warning.
reproduction: Run docker exec zenithtasks-app-1 sh -lc 'cd /app && npx eslint .'
expected: Lint gate is green before release.
businessImpact: Regression signals are ignored and future refactors become riskier.
recommendedFix: Fix all errors, decide the one warning, and enforce CI.

title: No repository Playwright/Cypress E2E suite
evidence: web/package.json includes Vitest but no Playwright or Cypress dependency/scripts.
expected: Critical role and browser workflows have automated coverage.
businessImpact: Permission, mobile, and multi-step regressions can reach users.
recommendedFix: Add isolated seeded Playwright flows and CI smoke coverage.

title: NPS duplicate protection is process-local
evidence: NpsResponse has no unique-per-customer/time-window constraint; portal action relies on in-memory bump().
reproduction: Submit concurrent or post-restart NPS requests for one token in an isolated DB
expected: Business rule is enforced by a transaction/database constraint.
businessImpact: Feedback metrics and patient history become unreliable.
recommendedFix: Add explicit uniqueness/business rule and idempotency key.

title: Rate limits reset on restart or multi-instance deployment
evidence: Public booking and portal actions use process-local bump() rate limits.
reproduction: Restart app or run two instances
expected: Rate limit is shared and resilient to restart.
actual: Protection is tied to one process lifetime.
businessImpact: Spam/abuse controls are weaker in production topologies.
recommendedFix: Use shared Redis/database rate limiting with clear limits and monitoring.

title: Debt plan does not enforce positive debt
evidence: cong-no/actions.ts reads debtAmount but only checks that the case exists before upsert.
expected: No debt plan unless policy permits it.
businessImpact: Debt follow-up and reports can contain false plans.
recommendedFix: Enforce the explicit debt invariant or remove the misleading comment/policy.

title: Untracked key file exists in checkout
evidence: git status reports PHONE_ENC_KEY-20260629-122122.txt as untracked and git check-ignore does not report it ignored. Value was not read.
reproduction: Run git status --short and git check-ignore -v on the file
expected: Key material is managed outside source checkout and excluded from packaging.
actual: A key-named file is present as untracked operational material.
businessImpact: Accidental commit, backup, or archive can expose encryption material.
recommendedFix: Move to managed secret storage, rotate if exposure is possible, and add safe ignore rules without hiding source secrets.

title: Security-header hardening is incomplete
evidence: Runtime response exposes X-Powered-By: Next.js and CSP contains unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.
expected: Defense-in-depth headers are minimized and CSP is as strict as the framework permits.
actual: Framework disclosure and permissive CSP directives remain.
businessImpact: Lower security hardening; not the primary release blocker.
recommendedFix: Remove X-Powered-By and tighten CSP after verifying hydration requirements.

title: Native date/time locale may conflict with Vietnamese copy
evidence: Observed in the tested browser locale; date/time controls displayed locale formatting different from surrounding Vietnamese UI.
reproduction: Open /dat-lich under an en-US browser locale
expected: Supported locale and timezone are clear and consistent.
businessImpact: Some patients may misread date/time or appointment expectations.
recommendedFix: Define locale/timezone behavior and test supported browsers; use explicit visible format where needed.
